assets.name: landscape
assets.prompt: Original artwork for DRACONIA, a native Godot strategy game set in a fictional late medieval Romanian Carpathian realm. Visual art direction inspired by Manor Lords: grounded naturalistic medieval rural materials, believable weathered stone and timber, restrained moss green, umber and muted ochre, no cartoon styling, no glowing neon, no text or logos. User reference has realistic dark forests and parchment manuscript UI. Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: cinematic landscape used as title scene and town panorama. Generate a very wide 3:2 image, high detail, naturalistic historical digital matte painting. View from a low hillside across a thriving Romanian medieval settlement in a misty Carpathian valley at late afternoon: timber cottages with steep wooden shingle roofs, garden strips, smoky hearths, muddy branching tracks, grazing cattle, a dignified stone fortress on a wooded ridge and a small painted monastery tower. Mountains fade into cloud behind. Village sits middle right, left third is quieter misted meadow for a game title. No giant fantasy architecture, no people close up, no UI. Strong cinematic light with restrained realistic palette, crisp enough to crop.
